# Releases and support for .NET
## Currently supported versions
- .NET 10 ( [Long Term Support](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/core/releases-and-support#release-tracks)) - supported until November 2028.
- .NET 9 ( [Standard Term Support](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/core/releases-and-support#release-tracks)) - supported until November 2026.
- .NET 8 ( [Long Term Support](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/core/releases-and-support#release-tracks)) - supported until November 2026.

## Release types
- .NET 8 and .NET 9 are major releases.
